name: brix-theme
description: BRIX 22° — кастомна тема WordPress для specialty-обсмажувальні (SCSS + BEM, WooCommerce, без білдерів)

scripts.css: sass assets/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --style=expanded --no-source-map --no-charset && sass assets/scss/editor.scss assets/css/editor.css --style=expanded --no-source-map --no-charset && npm run css:critical
scripts.build: sass assets/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --style=compressed --no-source-map --no-charset && sass assets/scss/editor.scss assets/css/editor.css --style=compressed --no-source-map --no-charset && npm run css:critical
scripts.zip: npm run zip:theme && npm run zip:core && echo 'Готово: wp-content/dist/brix.zip і brix-core.zip'
scripts.zip:theme: npm run build && git -C ../.. archive --format=zip --prefix=brix/ -o dist/brix.zip HEAD:themes/brix && cd .. && zip -q ../dist/brix.zip brix/assets/css/main.css brix/assets/css/editor.css brix/assets/css/critical.css && cd brix && npm run css
